page.notes: The first word "immuant" and the second word "affert" are read with some doubt; the scan is blurred there. The text is printed as set; "Responsa" and "potest" are a possible misreading of the line break and are read as printed. The line ends with the catchword "Judicii" at the right, which is not repeated in the text. The reading of the mid-line hyphen in "a- pertius" follows the printed line end.
